messages:
Sam: Recap from the postmortem: repeated vendor auth throttles are creating a cascade into model-registry and hitting our region stickiness. We need short-term mitigations + verification plan so these follow-ups close.
Maya: thanks. can we list the concrete weakest links to fix first?
Sam: sure: (1) token refresh floods during provider maintenance -> 429s, (2) client treats 401/429 identically and floods retries, (3) sticky routing TTL + cache pins traffic to same region so failover doesn't engage.
Liam: I'll take vendor comms and ask for explicit maintenance windows and rate-limit guidance. Will open SR and request prioritized channel.
Arjun: I'll take the client patch: separate 401 (refresh) vs 429 (backoff), add jittered exp backoff, and cap concurrent refreshes. ETA: 4 business days.
Tess: I'll own routing: drop sticky-routing TTL to 25s for model-registry flows, add explicit on-auth-error region fallback. Plan a 10% canary for 72h. ETA: 6 days.
Jules: infra will add a synthetic failure job to staging that injects 429 bursts and measures queue depth/tail latency. I'll also add an alert when retry rate > baseline * 5. ETA: 3 days.
sre-oncall-bot: Follow-up incident created INC-2026-11-09-221. Reminder set for owners in 72h.
Sam: Action items (to track in postmortem follow-up doc):
- A1: Arjun -> client changes (jitter + split-status handling + concurrent refresh guard). Deliverable: PR + integration test. Due: 4 business days.
- A2: Liam -> vendor SR + SLA ask + historical rate-limit windows. Deliverable: SR log + summary. Due: 10 business days.
- A3: Tess -> routing TTL change + canary plan. Deliverable: rollout doc + telemetry queries. Due: 6 business days.
- A4: Jules -> synthetic injection job + alert rule (retry storm). Deliverable: job + alert + runbook. Due: 3 business days.
- A5: Sam -> update postmortem with owners/ETAs and create follow-up tickets linked to INC. Deliverable: updated postmortem + ticket list. Due: EOD next business day.
Liam: opened SR-78301, asked for historical throttling windows and contact for urgent incidents. Will post replies in the follow-up doc.
Arjun: sample backoff I'll implement:```
// pseudo
base = 200ms
attempt++
if status == 429 {
  wait = (base * 2^attempt) + rand(0, base) + 800ms
} else if status == 401 {
  triggerTokenRefresh();
  wait = base // single quick retry after refresh
}
```
Tess: TTL canary: 10% traffic -> 72h -> monitor p95 latency and token-miss rate. Rollback if p95 increases > 8% or token-miss rate > 1%.
Jules: synthetic job will post PASS/FAIL and SLO drift to #incidents-alerts to validate before rollout.
Sam: schedule check-in in 72h to review PRs and SR progress. @deploy-bot can you create?
deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Auth & Model-registry Mitigation Check" Thu Nov 11 09:00am PT. Invite: Sam, Maya, Liam, Arjun, Tess, Jules.
sre-oncall-bot: Reminder: A1 due in 4 business days.
Maya: please keep thread quiet and use the follow-up doc for updates. I'll publish the trend card showing the three-event cluster.
Arjun: will post PR link + test results in doc.
Liam: will paste vendor responses in the doc.
Jules: will add runbook steps for engineers to trigger the synthetic test on demand.
Sam: thanks all. Closing here; reconvene at the 72h check-in.
